admission.reason: Apple contracts identify a testable per-file candidate, but no Darwin runtime report or benchmark-closure integration exists; dedicated system-cold is also missing

candidate_experiment.fixture: 16 MiB deterministic regular file, unlinked before any cache operation
required_observations: all fixture pages resident after explicit touch
residency immediately after fd-local F_NOCACHE toggle
byte-identical structured observations across two fixtures

official_manuals.contract: turns data caching off or on for the file descriptor
returns current in-core residency per mapped page
invalidates cached data in the mapped range
advises that the mapped range is not expected to be accessed soon; it is not an eviction proof

bsd/kern/kern_descrip.c.evidence: F_NOCACHE toggles fileglob FNOCACHE and F_GLOBAL_NOCACHE toggles vnode nocache; neither fcntl case performs an eviction or residency check

bsd/sys/fcntl.h.evidence: F_NOCACHE is fd-local and F_GLOBAL_NOCACHE is global for the file

file_content_nonresident_metadata_warm.candidate: fully warm an mmap, apply msync(MS_SYNC|MS_INVALIDATE), then require per-page mincore residency to be zero
rejected_substitutes: F_NOCACHE or F_GLOBAL_NOCACHE without eviction proof
a successful control call without per-page evidence

system_cold.basis: no reviewed public per-process contract proves system-wide file data and metadata cold; use a disposable dedicated reboot boundary
